chapters: Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr koi'm gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Moab bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu vaak ga'ra' gu Samaria; gio ba' kua' ka'ook bhañ gu takarui' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Bayan jix duñia' gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon tu' no'ñ gu jodai' dhi' ko'kdai'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham; gio ba' bamii' jix tɨ'ɨ gu takarui' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Samaria daipu'; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel gu takarui' jix búup gu ñi'ook gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon.
Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' dhim jix tɨ'ɨ cham gu oi'ñga'n va'k koi gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu Eliiyas ka't.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu takarui' suulh gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu Bayan gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhañ ja'xñi; jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon gu ux gu jodai' dhim jix tɨ'ɨ cham gu oi'ñga'n va'k koi tɨɨda'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu vaak ka't mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ jix duñia' jix aa' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chio'ñ jix bhai'x gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix aa'; jano' ba' gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu suudai' mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx jix tɨ'ɨ; gio ba' gu suudai' ka't daakat gu ux gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas gu suudai' mambhɨɨx; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tai gu tɨkɨr gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav gu tai gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' tɨip gu suudai' mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; gio ba' tu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' tu' tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu chuukug jootom.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tai gu tɨkɨr gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav gu tai gu tɨkɨr jix duñia' mambhɨɨx.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' tɨip vaik gu suudai' mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ mii' dhɨr vaik gu suudai' mambhɨɨx jix duñia' kɨkbok vupui bhaan gu Eliiyas jix duñia' bham; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' ka't gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' dhi' ja'tkam mambhɨɨx tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' jix duñia' gu tai gu tɨkɨr tu' gu oi'ñga'n gook dharka' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx bɨɨx mambhɨɨx; gio ba' ka't jano' gu oidha' gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas; gio ba' gu chuukug bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr cham cham tu'x jai'ch ɨɨbhi'ñ; jano' ba' jix búup jix dhaav bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Baal-sebub gu Jawatan Dios gu Ekroon cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel na ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu jodai' dhim jix tɨ'ɨ va'k koi tɨɨda'.

Jano' ba' jix koi jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu Eliiyas; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Joram gook oi'ñga' gu Joram gu mar gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; na gu' gu suudai' cham ga'ra' gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' cham ua'nak u'uan gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu Eliiyas gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨkɨr gu Eliiyas gu jodai' bɨɨx gu Eliseeo gu Gilgal.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas gu Eliseeo; na gu' tu' gu jodai' jano' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Bet-el; mi' dhɨr gu Eliseeo jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' mi'x dhaas; gio ba' jix dhaav gu Bet-el.

Jano' ba' gamai' gu Eliseeo gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mi'p gu Bet-el gui'p; gio ba' ñɨidhat na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan mo'o jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba' jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' gu Eliiyas jix duñia' a'ga; na gu' gu Eliseeo tu' gu jodai' jano' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerikoo; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' mi'x dhaas; gio ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Jerikoo.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Eliseeo gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mi'p gu Jerikoo gui'p; gio ba' ñɨidhat gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan mo'o jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu'; jano' ba' jix duñia'.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliiyas; na gu' jix duñia' tu' gu bhóogɨt na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jordaan; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham tu' mi'x dhaas; gio ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gook.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu suudai'; gio ba' gook gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' dhaagɨk jano' ba' gu Eliiyas gu takarui' jix duñia' naaka'n gu suudai' jix duñia' maa'n gu ñi'ook jix gaki.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p a'lhiok gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Eliiyas gu Eliseeo; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' va'k ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n bɨndak; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Eliseeo; jano' ba' jix duñia' gook gu bhóogɨt gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ ka't bhaan tu'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux jix duñia'; na pai' dhuuk tu' jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk ka't gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' ka't gu ñi'ook; gu' tu' cham.
Jano' ba' ka't jiimchu' a'gi'ñchu' gu suudai' gu duukam gu tai bɨɨx kavaayo gu tai jix ai'chdhix gook; gio ba' gu Eliiyas jix tɨ'ɨ gu tɨkɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Eliseeo tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu taat gu chuukug gu taat gu chuukug gu duukam gu Israeel gu ja'tkam kavaayo cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n jix ñi' gu oi'ñga'n jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gook gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu Eliiyas ka't gu vaak jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jugii'ñ gu Jordaan.
Ba' jix aa' dhaagɨk gu takarui' gu Eliiyas ka't gu vaak naaka'n gu suudai'; gio ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu Eliiyas ka't gu jodai' gu suudai' jix duñia' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo.

Jano' ba' jimchu' gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan mi'p gu Jerikoo baasɨ'n gui'p; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Eliiyas jix utu'ñ bhaan gu Eliseeo; mi' dhɨr tɨɨtɨs gu takarui' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' cham tu'x jai'ch bɨɨx tu duukam mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt jano' gu suudai' gu Jawatan; jano' ba' gu kutun tu' jix duñia' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' baas gu kutun gu kavɨk gu kutun gu suudai'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jum xibhɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' mɨjɨ mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ gu ñi'ook vaik gu tanoolh gu' cham gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' na pai' dhuuk suulh ka't jix duñia' gu Jerikoo; gio ba' cham tu ñi'ook tu' cham gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ kiicham gui'p gu Eliseeo; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook dhi' kiicham jix bhai' na ja'p gu Jawatan tu'; gu' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oidha' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ.
Ba' jix aa' gamai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix buus; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu suudai' cham gu oi'ñga'n koi'm tu' ko'kdai'.
Ba' jix aa' jix bɨɨx duu jix duñia' gu suudai' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix tɨ'ɨ gu Bet-el; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu bhóogɨt moor gu ñi'ook kiicham jix duñia' bham; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x jix tɨ'ɨ jix bhai'x jix tɨ'ɨ.
Ba' jix aa' tɨɨgɨk gu suudai' jix ñi' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' moor gook gu suudai' gu kavɨk jix duñia' oo'm gook gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu kavɨk gu Karmelo jix duñia' gu Samaria.
Jano' ba' gu Joram gu mar gu suudai' kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Samaria bhaan gu Israeel oi'ñga' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu kutun gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios gu ux cham na ja'p gu taat gu naan; na gu' jix duñia' dhi' gu Baal gu taat ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' jix duñia' uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu tasi' uañi'ñ gu Israeel; gio ba' cham jix ai'chdhix.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Mesa gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x ali' karneer gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu chuukug bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' jix koi gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix duñia' bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix buus jano' ba' gu Samaria gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram jix duñia' bɨx gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't bhañ a'ga gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt tu' gu chuukug bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Moab jix aa'; na gu' tu jiim na gu' na ja'p tu'; gio ba' na ja'p gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr na ja'p kavaayo gio kavaayo.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu bhóogɨt oidha' jix gaki gu chuukug.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug; gio ba' na ja'p jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu ux oidha' jix gaki kɨɨv gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu suudai' na ba' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham na ba' gu vaakax oi'ñchu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' tu' tɨɨgim gu Jawatan Dios dhi' ja'tkam vaik gu gɨ'kora' na ba' kɨɨsa' gu noobh gu Moabitas.

Ba' jix aa' gu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ux maa'n tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu Eliseeo gu mar gu Sapat jix duñia' gu suudai' gu noobh gu Eliiyas.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' dhi' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix dhaav gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliseeo gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ tu' bɨndak tu' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu taat jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu naan; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix aa'; jano' ba' cham; na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' ja'tkam vaik gu gɨ'kora' na ba' kɨɨsa' gu noobh gu Moabitas.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliseeo; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n dhi' tu' cham gu takarui' gu i'ii'ñ gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa cham gu chuukug tu' gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' jano' gu jodai' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix duñia' gu novɨ gu Jawatan Dios ka't bhaan gu Eliseeo.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr xoi'kam dhi' gu suudai' mumua'da' gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jɨvɨl tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhuuk dhi' gu suudai' ka't jix bhuup gu suudai' i'i gu takarui' gu vaakax gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' maa'n gio gu Moabitas gu noobh.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook bɨx kiicham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' jix duñia' bɨx jix bhai' gu u'u jix duñia' bɨx suudai' buusñi gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu jodai bɨx gu oidha' gu takarui'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu ux gu xibh na pai' dhuuk gu chuukug gu maa'nkar gu suudai' tɨɨtɨs gu suudai' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu oidha' ka't jix bhuup gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Moab na ja'p gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux bhaan jum daa'ñ dɨr bɨx tu jiim gu ñi'ook jiix jix dhaas gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix búup gu ux gu xibh jix duñia' gu tas bhaan gu suudai' jix duñia' gu Moab dɨr gu suudai' jix vɨgɨ na ja'p gu ɨ'ɨr.
Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ɨ'ɨr dhi' gu kuchii gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ maa'n tu' jix koi duiñchu'; mi' dhɨr jano' gu Moab gu ja'tkam.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' yooxi' gu Israeel jix búup gu Israelitas jix duñia' gu Moab jiboi'ññor vupui bhaan; gio ba' bhiadat cham gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt gu Moab.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh bɨx dɨppɨr gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' maa'n gu jodai jix bhuup; gio ba' jix duñia' gio bɨx suudai' buusñi gu suudai' jix duñia' bɨx jix bhai' gu u'u; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx ka'm gu Kir-areset gu suudai' mi'x dhaas gu jodai; na gu' gu chuukug jix duñia'.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix ñi' gu chuukug gu takarui' jix bhɨɨ baidhak gu chuukug gu chichio'ñ jix duñia' gu kuchii na ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu chuukug; gu' cham jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' maa'nkam mar ka't gu ñi'ook pai' maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan maa'nkar tai bhaan bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't jix gɨ' gu duukam gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' suulh gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan tu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo bham; gio ba' tu duukam gu chio'ñ jix koi; mi' dhɨr tu' ñɨidhat tu duukam ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' tu' tɨbiap gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' jix bhɨɨ gook gu ma'nkam gu suudai' gu ux tu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliseeo; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu vaak; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' ja'tkam na tu juan matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ juraa'n gu vaak gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' jix duñia' na ba' tu' gu ux gu suudai' bɨx gu takarui' gu ux gu jodai' cham gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' ba'k gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ki'ñgob bhaan tu' bhaan gu ma'nkam; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ bɨx gu ux kua' maa'n jix bhuup gu ñi'ook dɨlhkob.
Jano' ba' ta'tak gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob bhaan gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu jodai' jootos bɨ'ñdhatu'.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p gu ux jix bɨɨx duu jix bhuup gu mar gu kutun; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ux; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu oi'ñga'n gu ux; gio ba' jano' ba' jix utu'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' bi'iix bɨ'ñdhatu' gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ma'nkam gu chuukug jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gio gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo gu ux gu Sunem; gio ba' ka't gu u'vɨ gɨ'kora' ja'tkam jix duñia' jugi gu takarui'; na pai' dhuuk gu ux gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu vaak jugi gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ; gio ba' gu suudai' jano' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ux bɨɨx tas gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu vaak gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan.

Na pai' dhuuk tu' soi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu maa'nkar gu jodai' gu takarui' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook mɨichdhai na ba' na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n no'ch gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh suudai' u'va gu ux jix duñia' mii' dhɨr gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix koox.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; gio ba' mɨmɨim dhi' gu Sunamita; mi' dhɨr na ja'p jup tɨɨt jix duñia' vupui bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook no'ch bɨɨx bɨx dhi' gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook tu' gu chuukug tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix aa'; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook chulhiiñchuda' gu ux gu oi'ñga'n jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' cham juraa'n gu mar gu chio'ñ jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ jix dhaas bhaan gu takarui' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix kup ki'ñgob jix buus.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook cham gu ja'tkam gu masad tu' juanda'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' bhai'x i'ii'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr jix duu gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai' gu takarui'; gio ba' gu takarui' jiim; na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk tu' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' ta'tak suudai' u'va gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu kavɨk gu Karmelo; na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ gu takarui' jix ñi' gu suudai' jix aa' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu Sunamita.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jano' jix duñia' tu jiim gu takarui'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ gu mar jix aa'; mi' dhɨr bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Jano' ba' baakɨk jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob bhaan gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu suudai' jix aa'; jano' ba' jix duñia' jugi gu ja'tkam; gio ba' cham ka't gu oi'ñga'n cham bhai' gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' baakɨk gu Naamaan gu Jawatan gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook tɨɨyax gu oidha' gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gio gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel am:―Ja'pji; gio ba' gu chuukug tu' dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu ux tu' jootsa' tu' tu duukam gu Naamaan na ba' gu jodai' dua'ñdha'.

Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu jodai' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' jix duñia' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt jix maa gu oidha' na ba' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu bhóogɨt gu chio'ñ dua'ñdha' jix duñia' jano' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tu jiim bua' bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Eliseeo gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't gu oi'ñga'n jajannulhi'ñ bhañ a'ga gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jajannulhi'ñ gu oi'ñga'n jano' tu' gu chuukug cham tu'x jai'ch jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu Naamaan bɨɨx kavaayo bɨɨx gu duukam gu ñi'ook kiki'ñgob gu vaak gu Eliseeo.

Jano' ba' gu Abana gu Parpar gu jodai' gu Damasko cham tutkɨ bɨx gu suudai' gu Israeel tu' gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a cham jix duñia' gio na jix bhai' jix duñia' ka't jix bhai'x.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix dhaav jix duñia' kɨɨv mui'kim gu Jordaan jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu chuukug jix duñia' na ja'p gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ka't na jix bhai'.

Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bɨx chu'p jix dhaas vupui bhaan; gio ba' gu suudai' jano' kakasnira' cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu takarui' gu kutun gu o'o tu duukam.

Jano' ba' gu chuukug jano' gu Jordaan jix bhɨɨ maa'n gu duukam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ pai' gu jodai'; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' duukat jix duñia' pai'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; jano' ba' jix duu gu suudai' jix kavɨk jodai.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu novɨ jix bhɨɨ.
Ba' jix aa' ga'ra' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan gu Israeel gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tu duukam; gio ba' gu suudai' pai' jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bhañ a'ga gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel; na gu' gu suudai' cham gu ñi'ook gu ux jix duñia' pai' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel bhañ mii' dhɨr pai' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' nukadham cham jix duñia' tu' gook.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ka't gu oi'ñga'n dhi'; gio ba' tɨɨt tu duukam jix aa'; mi' dhɨr cham gu ñi'ook gu takarui' chɨkka gu oi'ñga'n gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' duukat na ba' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bhɨɨ; mi' dhɨr ka't tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu Dotaan.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu ñi'ook jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham tɨɨtɨs gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook kiicham.

Jano' ba' kɨkbo gu xibh gu oi'ñga'n gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix buus gu suudai' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham ga'ra' mia'n kiicham bɨɨx gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' jix duñia' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n chulhiiñchuda'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham cham tu'x jai'ch ɨɨbhi'ñ; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx no'ch bɨɨx.

Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Eliseeo; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu vupui na ba' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu vupui gu takarui' jix duñia'; jano' ba' gu suudai' gu kavɨk ka't jix bhuup gu ja'tkam kavaayo gu ñi'ook gu tai xikoolh gu Eliseeo.

Ba' jix aa' jix duñia' gu Samaria gu Eliseeo; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu vupui suulhgia' na ba' gu jodai'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu vupui jix duñia' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ka't gu oi'ñga'n jix gɨ' jugi; gio ba' na ja'p a'lhiok jugi gu takarui' bhañ suulh gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨtɨs gu chuukug gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook jum daa'ñ bɨx ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix tɨ'ɨ jix dhaas jix duñia' gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' ka't jix gɨ' bhiogi' gu Samaria da'p jix duñia' bhaan; gio ba' gu jodai' mo'o gu ñi'ook ka't gu suudai' gu ux jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu takarui' giokda' gu ux jixchamaam gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai.
Ba' jix aa' bhɨi gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu ux gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ jix maa jiiñak; gio ba' dodhia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu' cham tu' dodhia' gu Jawatan Dios duukat tu' no'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' ulhña' gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu u'vɨ jix aa'; jano' ba' jix maa jix bhai'x gu mar jugi gu ñi'ook gu xibh jugi gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu mar jugi; gio ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix maa jix bhai'x gu mar jugi; gu' tu' gu jodai' na jix uam gu mar.

Jano' ba' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' jix kai gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ux gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bhaan gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' tu' mo'o gu Eliseeo gu mar gu Sapat jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ka't gu jodai' gu Eliseeo daakat gu vaak bɨɨx mi'p gu bhóogɨt daraa; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' bhañ gu chio'ñ; gu' va'k mattuda' gu suudai' jix aa' daraa; na pai' dhuuk cham jix duñia' buupui gu ñi'ook dhi' gu mar mua'kam gu jodai' gu suudai' mo'o gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n mattuda' jix kup ki'ñgob gu chuukug ba'k; gio ba' cham jupaabkamu'n bhaan tɨroon tɨɨt gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' ka't a'gi'ñchu' bɨɨx gu suudai' mattuda' tɨmñim; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook dhi' cham bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jupaabkamu'n; jano' ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook no'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliseeo; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' gu xibh dhi' gu kavɨk gu takarui' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug gu vaak gu bhóogɨt gook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob gu Samaria.

Ba' jix aa' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' jano' gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr gu suudai' dhi' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu vupui gu' cham jugi gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' ka't maakobh gu chichio'ñ tootolhidhat ba'k ki'ñgob gui'p maa'n; gio ba' na ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' bɨɨx ka'm vaak jodai.

Jano' ba' tu' gu suudai' baakɨi kiicham gu ux bhiogi' cham tu'x jai'ch kiicham koi; gio ba' tu' gu takarui' gio koi; mi' dhɨr gu chuukug jano' gu jodai' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' tu' jix maa gu oidha' duaka'; gio ba' tu' jix maa koi'm koi.
Jano' ba' jix búup gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu tukaa' na ba' jix duu yooxi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu chuukug tumiiñku dhi' gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu chio'ñ.

Na gu' na gu' gu Jawatan ka't gu ñi'ook yooxi' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook tɨroon kavaayo gu i'ii'ñ jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel tu' gu chuukug bhaan no'ch gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu Egipkios na ba' gu bhóogɨt bhaan no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu tukaa' gu ñi'ook vaak zel kavaayo gu ñi'ook yooxi' na ja'p ka't; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tasi'.

Jano' ba' na ja'p tootolhidhat jix duñia' tumiiñku dhi' baap vaak zel koi'mɨk i'i jix bhɨɨ jix toja jodai jix uam jodai jajannulhi'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook baap vaak zel gio jix bhɨɨ jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gui'p maa'n; gio ba' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ xoi'kam; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh jix bhai' gu maa'nkar no'ch gu jodai'; jano' ba' tu' gu takarui' bɨɨx ka'm gu tasi' gu xibh jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai'; gio ba' gu chuukug jano' kapbhai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs jix maa jiiñak nuuka'n ki'ñgob kiicham gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' no'ch gu oi'ñga'n yooxi' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' cham ka't gu chio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook kavaayo gu ñi'ook gio gu ñi'ook yooxi' na ja'p ka't.
Jano' ba' gu duukam jix maa jiiñak gu ñi'ook gu kutun gu gɨ'kora'.

Ba' jix aa' jix búup gu gɨ'kora' gu tukaa' tu duukam; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ tañia' bhiogi' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak zel gu bhóogɨt yooxi' bham; na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook kiicham jix bhɨɨ ko'iix ba'k kiicham.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' maa'n tu duukam; na gu' jix bhɨɨ jano' jixchamaam kavaayo jix duñia' kiicham na gu' gio na ja'p bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel tu' jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gio na ja'p bɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Israeel tu' gu suudai'; jano' ba' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n cham tu'x jai'ch.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gook kavaayo gu duukam bhañ gu gɨ'kora' bhaan yooxi' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bhiadat bɨɨx ka'm gu Jordaan; gio ba' gu suudai' bɨx gu bhóogɨt ka't jix bhuup jajannulhi'ñ gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr suulh gu takarui' jix duu maachim gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam jix buus jix duñia' yooxi' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug gu vaak gu ux gu bhóogɨt gook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas ki'ñgob mii' dhɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam bhaan gu novɨ jix duñia'; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ja'tkam ba'k jix koi jurtu'nka' ka't tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaav.

Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bham; gio ba' gook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu chuukug gu vaak ka't jix duñia' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu xibh dhi' gu kavɨk ki'ñgob gu Samaria.

Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gɨ'kora' ja'tkam ka't tu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu ux gu Jawatan Dios gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr gu jodai' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx gu vupui gu' cham jugi gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va; na gu' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' ba'k jix koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu Eliseeo mii' dhɨr gu u'vɨ gu mar ka't gu ñi'ook duaka' bham; gio ba' bamii' gu chuukug tu' bɨx gu vaak duaka' pai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨɨgim bhiogi' ɨlhdham gio bhaan gu oidha' kɨɨv gu takarui'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu u'vɨ jix búup jix duu na ja'p gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' ta'tak bɨɨx ja'tkam vaak jix oidha' gu oidha' gu Pilisteos kɨɨv gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix bɨɨx duu gu oi'ñga'n kɨɨv gu takarui' gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu oidha' gu Pilisteos; gio ba' mi' dhɨr jix buus na ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ux gu vaak gu ux oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' ka't gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bɨx kɨɨ'p tu' gu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook duaka' jix koi gu suudai' gu u'vɨ gu mar ka't gu ñi'ook duaka' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu ux gu vaak gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Jawatan gu chuukug dhi' gu u'vɨ dhi' gu mar gu Eliseeo jix duu duaka'.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' jix maa gu bhóogɨt tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu jiim gu ñi'ook bɨx tu'x jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n bɨx gu i'bhɨ oi'ñga'n dɨr gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n bɨɨx ka'm jano'.
Jano' ba' gu Eliseeo ka't gu Damasko gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook ka't ka'ook jix maa aa'ñdham bham; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios tu' tɨbiap.
Ba' jix aa' gu gɨ'kora' gu asael; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu novɨ gu o'o tu' gu takarui' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios bham; mi' dhɨr no'ñ gu jodai' dhi' ko'kdai'.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu asael gu novɨ gu o'o bɨx jix bhai' gu Damasko oo'm jix ai gu ñi'ook jix buus gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' jix dhaas vupui bhaan jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu mar gu Ben-adad gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' bham; jano' ba' no'ñ gu jodai' dhi' ko'kdai'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eliseeo; gio ba' tu' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jix bhai'x ii'mdagaram; gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' koi gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu vupui jix bhai'x juruuñ gu oi'ñga'n; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu asael; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan jix aa'; na gu' tu' cham bhai' duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu tai biipibop koo'nda' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' a'aalh bhi'spio'kai gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu asael; gio ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook tu duukam gagai' jix duñia' dhi' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix aa' gu Eliseeo; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu oi'ñga'n tu' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' ta'tak gu Eliseeo suudai' u'va gu Jawatan; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Eliseeo jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix aa' jix bhai'x ii'mdagaram.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak jix bhɨɨ gu tanoolh gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu suudai' jix duñia' bhaan gu vupui gu Ben-adad jix koi; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' gu asael pai'.
Jano' ba' jixchamaam oi'ñga' gu Joram gu mar gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu suudai' gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Joram gu mar gu Josapat gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook gook gu takarui' ka't na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu tasi' gu takarui' jix gɨ'kora' gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel na ja'p gu vaak gu suudai' na gu' mar u'vɨ gu suudai' ka't gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jix duu cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam na ja'p ka't jix duñia' jix maa gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Edom bɨtaa'n gu novɨ gu Judaa jix dhaas gu gɨ'kora' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu Joram gu ux gu jodai' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx; gio ba' kɨkbo gu tukaa' naaka'n gu chuukug gu suudai' mia'n gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ja'tkam jix duñia' dhi'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu ñi'ook gu Edom gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Judaa bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Libna gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Joram bɨx tu'x cham ua'nak u'uan gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Joram bɨɨx tattat ka't jix duñia' bɨɨx tattat kiicham gu Dabii; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu kutun gu suudai' gu mar.
Jano' ba' oi'ñga' gu kutun gu Joram gu mar gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu mar gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa.

Na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' ka't gu suudai' na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' oi'ñga' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Ataliia mar u'vɨ gu Omri gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix duu jix jiim gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu suudai' cham bhai' gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu vaak gu suudai'; na gu' ka't gu takarui' gu vaak gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx gu Joram gu mar gu suudai' gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Joram.

Na pai' dhuuk gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram jix duñia' gu Jesreel na ba' gu takarui' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook jix duu vupui bhaan gu Ramot na pai' dhuuk gu ux bhaan gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix dhaav gu suudai' gu mar gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa gu bhóogɨt gu Joram gu mar gu suudai' gu Jesreel na gu' ka't ka'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliseeo jup tɨɨt maa'n gu ma'nkam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ dhi' gu ux bɨ'ñdhatu' gu novɨ tu' gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu Jeuu gu mar gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Nimsi; gio ba' baakɨk gu vupui jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu ux bɨ'ñdhatu' gu bhóogɨt bhaan mo'o tu'; gio ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' maa'n gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob mi'x juu'ñ gu takarui' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu takarui' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' na ja'p chɨbiapui gu suudai' chiñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham mi'p gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook no'ñ gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Jeuu jix aa'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx no'ch jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix búup chɨbiapui gu vaak; gio ba' ja'aa bɨ'ñdhatu' bhaan mo'o jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; jano' ba' tu' maa'n gu ux gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak gu suudai' gu Jawatan na ba' tu' gu jodai' gu ɨ'ɨr tu duukam jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr bɨx tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jesabel.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx gu vaak gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨx gu jodai' gu maa'nkar nukadham na ja'p jix bhai'x gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu suudai' na ja'p gu vaak gu Jeroboam gu mar gu tasi' na ja'p gu vaak gu Baasa gu mar gu Aiia.
Jano' ba' gu Jesabel jugi gagai' yooxi' gu Jesreel cham gu oi'ñga'n gu jodai'; gio ba' gu jodai' jix kupi'ook ki'ñgob mi'x juu'ñ gu takarui'.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix buus gu Jeuu tu duukam gu Jawatan gui'p; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook chɨbiapui tu' mii' dhɨr gu takarui' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu duukam gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' jano'; jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' tu ñi'ook bham; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' tu' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook jix dhaas maa'n bɨtaa'n atooxkor jix bhai'x jix duñia' gu duukam gui'p; gio ba' gu Jeuu gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jeuu gu mar gu Josapat gu mar gu Nimsi bhaan gu Joram; gio ba' ka't gu Joram nukadham gu Ramot gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx bɨx gu Israeel gu ux kuiñcha gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' ka't cham gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram gu Jesreel na ba' gu takarui' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu ux bhaan gu asael gu gɨ'kora' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu Jeuu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr tu' aagak gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook kiicham na ba' tu' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jesreel.
Na gu' jano' ba' gu Jeuu jix duñia' ka't gu Jesreel na gu' gu Joram ka't ka'ook; gio ba' gio gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa ka't jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu Joram.

Ba' jix aa' gu oi'ñga'n ka't bhi'ñbak gu Jesreel jix ñi' gu chuukug gu Jeuu gu jodai'; gio ba' tu' gu jodai' gu chuukug; mi' dhɨr gu Joram jix aa'; jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ maa'n kavaayo gu jodai' gu takarui'; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ.

Ba' jix aa' ka't kavaayo gu takarui'; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jeuu jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt bhaan tu'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix maa aa'ñdham bham; mi' dhɨr mattuda' jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm cham gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bhañ kavaayo gu chuukug; gio ba' gu gɨ'kora' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jeuu jix aa'; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gio gu ux jix duñia' cham gu bhóogɨt; na gu' gu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jupaabkamu'n na ja'p gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jeuu gu mar gu Nimsi na gu' jupaabkamu'n jix bhai'x.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joram; gio ba' maa'n; mi' dhɨr maa'n ka't gu duukam jix buus gu Joram gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa maa'n gu duukam moor gu oi'ñga'n gu Jeuu gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Nabot gu Jesreel.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Joram gu Jeuu; gio ba' cham tu'x jai'ch bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu Jeuu jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu Jesabel gu naan mumua'da' gu suudai'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Joram gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ jix duñia' gu suudai'; gio ba' gu Traikioon gu suudai'.
Gu' gu' gu Jeuu gu duukam gu ñi'ook naaka'n gu Joram tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buus gu ux gu i'ii'ñ jix duñia' gu duukam.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jeuu gu Bidkar gu suudai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨnkam gu maa'nkar gu Nabot gu Jesreel; na pai' dhuuk gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk tu' gu ñi'ook tɨtda:―Aañ bɨɨx gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu taat gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' dhi' gu chuukug bhaan bham.

Ba' jix aa' tu' buupui gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr gu Nabot gu ɨ'ɨr gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' no'ñ gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt dhi' gu maa'nkar jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook jano' bɨnkam gu maa'nkar jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ dhi' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa jix duñia' gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu vaak u'uu pai'; gio ba' chɨ'ɨɨk gu Jeuu bham; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gio gu ux gu bhóogɨt; jano' ba' jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Gur ju'ñdharan gu Ibleam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Megiddo jix koi.
Jano' ba' tu duukam bhɨɨk gu duukam gu Jerusalem gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tattat tukga'n kiicham gu Dabii.
Jano' ba' maa'n oi'ñga' gu Joram gu mar gu suudai' kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bhaan gu Judaa.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va mi' dhɨr gu Jeuu gu Jesreel; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jesabel jix kai jix duñia' gu vupui bɨɨx gu jodai' jix duñia' mo'o jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' na ja'p jix duñia' gu Jeuu gu ux ki'ñgob; gio ba' jix duñia' xoi'kam gu Simri mu'aa gu Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt jano' ba' gu vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook; gio ba' chɨkka gu chuukug chɨkka tu jiim bhaan gook vaik gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' mi'x juu'ñ jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' mi'x juu'ñ; jano' ba' baasɨ'n gu ɨ'ɨr ka't gu jodai' gu maa'nkar kavaayo; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui mi' dhɨr jix jugi jix i'i; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jano' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr gu chuukug gu jodai'; na mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora'.
Na pai' dhuuk cham gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk jix bɨɨx duu na ba' gu ñi'ook cham gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a tɨɨt gu ñi'ook gu noobh.

Jano' ba' suulh tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug tu ñi'ook gu ux gu novɨ tu duukam gu Eliiyas gu Tisbita bham; jano' ba' gu maa'nkar gu Jesreel jugi gagai' gu chuukug gu Jesabel.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Jesabel ka't gu takarui' bhaan gu vupui gu oidha' gu maa'nkar gu Jesreel; gio ba' soo'mchulhdhak gu bhóogɨt a'ga; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu Jesabel.
Jano' ba' ga'ra' gu suudai' gu Samaria gu vaak gu ma'nkam; gio ba' ua'na gu bhóogɨt gu Jeuu bhañ gu Samaria gu ñi'ook gu Jesreel daraa gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bham.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug dhi' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' namki' gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan namki' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo kiicham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook tutkɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ atooxkor gu taat jix duñia' gu ux gu vaak gu Jawatan.
Gu' gu' chooto'n choo'n gui'p; gio ba' gu suudai' gook gu gɨ'kora' cham jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt no'ch.

Jano' ba' gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu ñi'ook kiicham daraa gu ñi'ook mɨjɨ a'ga gu Jeuu; gio ba' tu duukam gu jodai' gu'ch chulhiiñchuda' bɨx jix aa'ñdhix; mi' dhɨr cham gu jodai' gu ux gu gɨ'kora' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' tu' jix duu xoi'kam tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' ua'na gookim jix duñia' bham; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ ɨɨbhidham gu chichio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu xibh dhi' gu kavɨk tu' gu Jesreel; mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu vaak gu chichio'ñ mi'p bɨɨx gu ñi'ook kiicham gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' jix bhɨɨ gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu tasi' gu vaak gu chichio'ñ jix dhaas ɨɨbhidham gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' gu Jesreel.

Jano' ba' suudai' u'va mattuda' jix maa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bham; gio ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' ɨɨbhidham gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora'; mi' dhɨr jix aa'; jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gook gɨ' kavɨk ba'k ki'ñgob bɨɨx ka'm gu xibh.

Ba' jix aa' namkia' gu xibh jix buus kua' tɨɨt bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu takarui' jir bhai' ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr gu suudai' tu' gu jodai' bhaan gu Jawatan jix koi; jano' ba' gu' chɨkka tu' jix koi bɨx dhi' ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu bhóogɨt jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu vaak gu suudai' cham tu' gu chuukug gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu ñi'ook jix aa' gu ux tu duukam gu Eliiyas.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jano' ba' gu Jeuu bɨx gu suudai' jix duñia' gu vaak gu suudai' gu Jesreel bɨx chiñia' bɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan cham gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix búup suudai' u'va gu Samaria; gio ba' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu vaak gu bhóogɨt bipia'dam.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' chɨkka gu takarui' gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu'ch gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu jodai' tɨbiap tulhiiñdha' gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu tasi'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba'; gio ba' gu jodai' ko'iix; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ ko'iix gu tasi' ju'ñdharan oidha' suudai' gu vaak gu bhóogɨt oo'm gook gu chichio'ñ cham mi'x dhaas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu takarui' jix duñia' bɨɨx gu vaak gu mar gu Rekâb; gio ba' mi' dhɨr ka't tulhiiñdha' jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ na ja'p gu chuukug gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak jix aa'; jano' ba'; na gu' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ; mi' dhɨr jix maa gu novɨ; jano' ba' jix duu jix tɨ'ɨ baidhak gu bhóogɨt.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu kutun gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu ux gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas gu duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Jeuu gu ñi'ook gu Samaria jix duñia' bɨx a'ga jix duñia' gu suudai' gu Samaria bɨɨx ka'm gu bhóogɨt jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't tu ñi'ook gu ux gu Eliiyas.
Ba' jix aa' jum daa'ñ gu Jeuu bɨx gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu vaak gu Baal; gu' gu Jeuu tu juan jix jai'.

Jano' ba' mɨmɨim bɨx jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Baal bɨx tu duukam bɨx jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; na gu' cham jix duñia' maa'n na gu' no'ñ maa'nkar na jix bhaan Jawatan na ba' gu Baal; mi' dhɨr no'x jix duñia' cham ii'mdagaram; jano' ba' dhi' jix duñia' gu Jeuu bɨɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' cham tu' duu jix duñia' gu Baal.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jeuu; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tanoolh gu suudai' gu Baal; mi' dhɨr jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' bhañ gu Jeuu gu ux bɨx gu Israeel tɨɨtɨs bɨx tu duukam gu Baal cham jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham gu suudai'; gio ba' baap vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal jix bhuup gu maa'nkar.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' ga'ra' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' jix buusñi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' bɨx tu duukam gu Baal; mi' dhɨr jix buusñi gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' chɨbiapui gu Jeuu bɨɨx gu vaak gu mar gu Rekâb vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal tu duukam gu Baal; gio ba' gu suudai' gu jodai' gu ux tu ñi'ook cham ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tas tu duukam gu Baal.

Ba' jix aa' na ja'p baap na ba' duñia' makgɨrxi'ñdha' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jeuu jix dhaas mai' jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ; gio ba' no'x mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ tu' gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu oidha' ka't gu ux.

Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr jix bɨɨx duu duñia' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu Jeuu nukadham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' kapbhai' gu bhóogɨt; na cham gu takarui' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' mi'x dhaas gu ñi'ook nukadham gu ñi'ook jix bɨɨx duu bɨɨx ka'm kiicham vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu vaak gu Baal gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' dhi' gu Baal jix duñia' gu vaak gu Baal jix duu gu tasi' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Jeuu gu Baal gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jix duu bɨɨx bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jeuu cham jix ai'chdhix uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam gu mar gu tasi' jix duñia' gu Israeel; gio ba' maachim gu ñi'ook gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n jix uam jodai mi'p gu Bet-el gu Dan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jeuu; na gu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui gu oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu suudai' jurtu'nka' bɨx ka't gu i'ii'ñ gu ma'nkam jix duñia' bhaan atooxkor gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n.
Gu' gu' gu Jeuu cham jix duñia' jiim ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ tu' jix ai'chdhix uañi'ñ gu Jeroboam ka't gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh kua'da' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Israeel; gio ba' naaka'n gu asael bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu Jordaan gu jodai' gu tas bɨx gu oidha' gu Galaad gu Gad gu Rubeen gu Manasees dɨr gu Aroer ju'ñdharan gu jodai' gu Arnoon gu Galaad gu Basaan.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jeuu bɨx tu'x bɨx gu suudai' cham ua'nak u'uan gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koox gu Jeuu bɨɨx tattat gu ñi'ook gu Samaria; gio ba' jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu chuukug gu mar.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix gɨ'kora' gu Jeuu bhaan gu Israeel gu Samaria ka't gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu Ataliia gu naan gu suudai' ñɨi'ñ gu mar ka't jix koi jix búup jix duñia' bɨx gu kai' vaak ja'tkam.

Gu' gu' dhaagɨk gu Josaba mar u'vɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Joram gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu Joas gu mar gu suudai' jix buusñi jix bhai'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Ataliia gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim Cham cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' juruuñ bɨɨx gu jodai' na jix uam gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu ux gu takarui'; gio ba' gu Ataliia ka't gu ñi'ook bhaan gu oi'ñga'n.

Gu' gu' kɨɨv oi'ñga' bhañ gu suudai' jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam nukadham jix duñia' baidhak gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu bɨɨx gu takarui' gu suudai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' gu mar gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix bham; gio ba' dhi' jix duñia' a'ga; mi' dhɨr gu i'ii'ñ baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook jɨjɨkgɨm juanda' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu i'ii'ñ baasɨ'n jix duñia' ki'ñgob gu bhóogɨt gu i'ii'ñ baasɨ'n ki'ñgob gu takarui' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' nukadham gu vaak na ba' cham ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook maachim bɨx gɨgɨ'lhi'ñ juanda' jix duñia' jix nukadham gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios ju'ñdharan gu gɨ'kora'.

Jano' ba' no'm xikoolh gu gɨ'kora' gu bhóogɨt da'p maa'n gu ñi'ook gu noobh no'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook dhi' ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt ka't jix koi; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu chuukug bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duu bɨx na ja'p jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu suudai' jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' dhaagɨk maa'n gu oi'ñga'n maachim gu suudai' baakɨi juanda' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook juanda' tɨɨtɨs gu suudai' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix maa gu bhóogɨt gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' jix duñia' gu gɨ'kora' gu Dabii mi'p gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' nukadham jix dhaas gu vaak da'p maa'n gu ñi'ook gu noobh dɨr gu ñi'ook gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu mar gu gɨ'kora' jix dhaas kuruun chuut jix duu gu gɨ'kora' maa'n; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt gu noobh gui'p; mi' dhɨr gu tai gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Ataliia gu jodai' gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt chɨbiapui gu ja'tkam vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' na ja'p jix duñia' gu suudai' gu gɨ'kora' ka't ju'ñdharan gu vaak jurtu'nka' gu takarui' chiñia' gu bhóogɨt ju'ñdharan gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu suudai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' gu Ataliia jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Traikioon gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix buusñi mai' gu i'ii'ñ vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix aa' cham gu oi'ñga'n vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba'.
Jano' ba' jix maa pai' na ja'p gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt gu ux pai' ba'k kavaayo gu vaak gu gɨ'kora' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duu jano' ba' gu suudai' ñi'ook na jix bhaan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu suudai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ'kora' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' chɨbiapui vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Baal jix duñia'; gio ba' gu suudai' jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Mataan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Baal vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix dhaas gu takarui' bhaan gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook nukadham bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' bhɨɨk gu gɨ'kora' dɨr gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios tɨɨtɨs gu ux gu bhóogɨt ki'ñgob nukadham gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'; gio ba' jix daa gu gɨ'kora' bhaan atooxkor gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' jix duu bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha' gu suudai' kiicham juruuñ jɨɨpi'ñka' dhaibu jix duñia' gu Ataliia muukix gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu vaak gu gɨ'kora'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Joas kɨɨv gu takarui' na pai' dhuuk kua'da' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv oi'ñga' gu Jeuu kua'da' gu ñi'ook gu Joas jix gɨ'kora' oo'm gu takarui' gu Jerusalem; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu naan ka't gu Sibia gu Beer-seba.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios ka't bɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx tu'x busaak jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' naaka'n gio gu Pilisteos bɨɨx ka'm gu Gasa gu ñi'ook dɨr gu ñi'ook gu chuukug bɨɨx ka'm kiicham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' maakobh oi'ñga' gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas ka't oi'ñga' kɨɨv gu Oseas gu mar gu Ela gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel jix tɨ'ɨ gu Salmanasar gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios bhaan gu Samaria jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar vaik gu takarui'; gio ba' dhi' xijumai oi'ñga' gu Esekîas ka't oi'ñga' gu jodai' gu Oseas gu gɨ'kora' gu Israeel ka't gu Samaria jix bhɨɨ.
Jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bhaan gu Israeel gu Asiria jix dhaas gu ala gu abor ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu Gosaan jɨ'dɨlh gu Medos.

Na gu' na gu' cham gu suudai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios va'k gu suudai' jix bhai'x ñi'ook na jix bhaan; gio ba' bɨx tu'x gu Moisees tu duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix aa'ñdhix tu' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu ñi'ook gu ux tu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas jix tɨ'ɨ gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bhaan bɨx jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gu Judaa jix bhɨɨ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa bhañ a'ga gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu Lakîs; gio ba' tu' uañi'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt tu' gu jodai' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria gu takarui' gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa vaik cha'tmam jix toja jodai gu ñi'ook cha'tmam jix uam jodai.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu ux gu jodai' gu Esekîas bɨx jix toja jodai ka't bakia' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu takarui' gu vaak vaak ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu jodai' gu Esekîas kiki'ñgob vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas ka't jix bhaan dhaas jix uam jodai jix maa gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.

Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bhañ gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas dɨr gu Lakîs bhaan gu Jerusalem gu Tartaan gu Rabsaris gu Rabsakes bɨɨx jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ tɨɨtɨs gu Jerusalem; mi' dhɨr dhaibu jix tɨ'ɨ tɨɨtɨs gu ñi'ook ju'ñdharan gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook jiix gu bhóogɨt gu maa'nkar gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu gɨ'kora' jix buus gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias ka't gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Sebna gu o'o gu Joa gu mar gu Asap gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Rabsakes; gio ba' gu suudai' jano' gu Esekîas; mi' dhɨr tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook chotdonɨt dhi' tu' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ux tɨɨda' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu kutun no'ñ gu suudai' na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham; gu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan tu'.

Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jano' dhi' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto tu' oi'ñdha' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu ux gu novɨ gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Faraoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Ejipto na ba' bɨx jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' no'ch gu takarui' gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham gu bhóogɨt jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu Esekîas tu' tu ñi'ook gu Judaa gu Jerusalem; jano' ba' vupui bhaan dhi' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' gu Jerusalem.
Na ba' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' jano' tu' soi'ñ gu chuukug gu jodai' gu Jawatan gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria tu' gu suudai' gook jix bhai'x kavaayo tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug gu jodai' na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duu gu ñi'ook gu vupui gu suudai' jix ali' tu duukam gu Jawatan gu ux gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu Ejipto gu ux gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam kavaayo.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tɨbiap tu' jano' cham gu Jawatan Dios dhi' pai' na ba' cham tu' duu gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ dhi' gu oidha' gu takarui'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias gu Sebna gu Joa gu Rabsakes; na gu' jix duñia' tu ñi'ook tu duukam gu jodai' na gu' gu ñi'ook cham bɨɨx no'ch jix bhai'x maatɨt gu ja'tkam bhaan gu ñi'ook.

Ba' jix aa' gu Rabsakes; gio ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan tu' gu Jawatan na ba' a'ga dhi' gu ñi'ook cham va'k gu chichio'ñ bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' jugi gu takarui' i'i gu suudai' tɨɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Rabsakes tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x bham; gio ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora'; na gu' cham iatgi'ñdha' gu Esekîas na gu' cham gu kutun jix duñia' gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' cham gu oi'ñga'n gu Esekîas jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' tɨɨda' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' kiicham cham ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Na gu' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Esekîas na gu' tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' xoi'kam gu chuukug bhai'x i'ii'ñ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' maa'n jugi gu tasi' iigɨx maa'n i'i gu suudai' oidha' suudai'.

Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu oidha' na ja'p gu oidha' kai'ñ suudai' u'va pai' gu takarui' pai' u'va pai' gu ñi'ook bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' na jix do'ig cham koi; na pai' dhuuk cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Esekîas na gu' gu ñi'ook na pai' dhuuk tu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt oi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp tu' gu takarui' gu oidha' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu amat gu Arpad duukat gu Jawatan Dios gu Separbaim gu ena gu iba jix duñia' suulhgia' jix duñia' gu Samaria gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu Jawatan Dios oidha' gɨ' tu' gu takarui' oidha' gɨ' gu novɨ na ba' namkidhat gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gu chuukug cham tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook; na gu' ka't gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' ka't tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham tu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Eliakim gu mar gu ilkiias ka't gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Sebna gu o'o gu Joa gu mar gu Asap gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tɨɨtɨs gu Esekîas gu takarui' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Rabsakes.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas jix kai jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix bhaan dhaas gu ux chɨbiapui gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Eliakim gu vai'ñga'n na kɨ'n tu joi'ñ gu Sebna gu o'o daraa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan jajannulhi'ñ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Isaiiyas jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu mar gu Amoos.
Na tu ñi'ook; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Esekîas; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu tanoolh gu chuukug gu ja'tkam gu kutun; na gu' gu ma'nkam jix duñia' tɨbiap bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug gu ñi'ook cham juraa'n gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu kutun gu bhóogɨt gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Rabsakes gu gɨ'kora' gu Asirios gu Jawatan tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' naak; na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu takarui' soi'm gu ux gu suudai' bakia'.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas gu Isaiiyas.

Jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas jix aa'; gio ba' gu chuukug gu Jawatan; mi' dhɨr tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' cham jum i'obh gu ux gu ñi'ook naak bɨɨx jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' gu bhóogɨt gu oidha' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix suudai' duu gu Rabsakes gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria jugi gu Libna; na gu' ka't naak ka't gu suudai' gu Lakîs.
Jano' ba' jix kai a'ga gu Tiraka gu gɨ'kora' gu jodai'; gio ba' gu suudai' gu ñi'ook na ba' gu chuukug bhɨɨ'ñdham; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' jix duñia' bhañ gu chuukug gu Esekîas bham.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu Esekîas gu gɨ'kora' gu Judaa; gio ba' cham tu' iatgi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' a'ga; mi' dhɨr gu Jerusalem cham ka't kapbhai' gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' naak jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria bɨx oi'ñga'n gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chɨbɨɨp tattat gu chuukug maachim gu Gosaan jix duu gu Resep gu ma'nkam gu Edeen mi'p gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' duukat gu gɨ'kora' gu amat gu gɨ'kora' gu Arpad gu gɨ'kora' kiicham gu Separbaim gu ena gu iba.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Esekîas gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ gu chuukug; gio ba' mi' dhɨr ka't jiñkai'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Esekîas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu Esekîas vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel jix daa tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' tu' gu duukam gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'.

Jano' ba' gu Inklina gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios naak gu takarui'; gio ba' gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu vupui gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Sennakêrib tu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' tu'r gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria jix duñia' gu jodai' chɨbɨɨp oi'ñga'n.
Na gu' jix dhaas gu tai gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu noobh gu chichio'ñ gu u'u gu jodai gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chulhiiñdha' gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt gu novɨ na ba' gu bhóogɨt bɨx oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu oidha' tu' gu duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amoos bhañ a'ga gu Esekîas; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria naak.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook bhaan; gio ba' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook mar u'vɨ gu Sioon; mi' dhɨr tu' joi'mdak mo'o gu suudai' tu' mar u'vɨ gu Jerusalem.
Jano' ba' chɨkka jix duñia' chɨkka gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan chɨkka tu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu suudai' jix bhai'x gu vupui bhaan jix bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu ux gu novɨ gu takarui' gu jodai' jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan tu ñi'ook; gio ba' bɨɨx gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu oi'ñga'n gu kakkavɨk gu chuukug gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt gu duukam gɨ' u'u kavɨk cham tu'x jai'ch gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; jano' ba' ba'k jix koi gu oidha' gu kavɨk gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu takarui' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu vaas tɨɨt bɨx gu jodai' gu ñi'ook gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' cham pai' dhuuk naak jix jai' gu ñi'ook tu' gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook jano' gu ñi'ook jix ai ka't na ba' gu bhóogɨt jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk gɨ' kavɨk gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix koi jix bhai'x gu noobh gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu vaas yooxi' na ja'p gu tasi' gu vaas gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook va'k gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' tu' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt jix buus baakɨi i'iich bhaan tu'.

Na gu' na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu jodai' tu' jix tɨ'ɨ maatɨt tu' gu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu takarui' gu chin gu ñi'ook tu' gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook pai' gu jodai'.

Jano' ba' dhi' tu' ka't gu ux nɨi'ñchudat gu Esekîas; gio ba' dhi' oi'ñga' jugi gu tasi' gu kutun gook oi'ñga' gu tasi' gu kutun; mi' dhɨr vaik oi'ñga' jix duu gu chuukug gook gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va jugi gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu vaak gu Judaa jix duñia' mi'x juu'ñ tatk gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu i'bhɨ jiix.
Na gu' na gu' gu ñi'ook gu Jerusalem gu suudai' jix duñia' gu kavɨk gu Sioon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios chugi'ñ jix duñia' dhi'.

Na ba' gu ux gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' cham jix duñia' dhi' kiicham tu' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr tu' ɨlhdham vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook tu' ka't baas bhaan gu duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu bhóogɨt suudai' u'va gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' dhi' kiicham tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' na gu' tu' gu ñi'ook dhi' kiicham na ba' dodhia' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tukaa' jix buus nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n yooxi' gu Asirios chamaam jix bhai'x jixchamaam jix bhai'x; gio ba' na ja'p jix búup gu ux gu xibh gu suudai' gu chuukug koko'kam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Sennakêrib gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria ta'tak ka't jix duñia' gu Niinibe pai' juruuñ.

Jano' ba' ka't kua' jix duñia' vaak na jix bhaan Jawatan gu Nisrok gu Jawatan Dios gu Adramelek gu Saresar maraa'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jiboi'ññor gu oidha' gu Ararat; mi' dhɨr jix gɨ'kora' pai' gu Esar-adoon gu mar.

Ba' jix aa' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh jix duñia' gu Esekîas ka'ook koi'm suudai' u'va gu Isaiiyas gu mar gu Amoos; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; na gu' gu chuukug gu vaak na gu' koi cham ii'mdagaram.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix duñia' gu vupui gu maa'nkar jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook chɨ'ñchoka' gu bhóogɨt vupui bhaan tu' tu'r bɨx bhai' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook tu'x tu' gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Esekîas bɨɨx suanda'.
Jano' ba' va'k gu Isaiiyas gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨɨx ka'm tɨjɨɨ'ñ naadat ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Isaiiyas bham.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt tu' gu Esekîas gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Dabii gu taat; mi' dhɨr tu' naak soi'm buupui suakɨt; jano' ba' gu suudai' tu' gu ja'tkam; gio ba' vaik gu tanoolh jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' tu' gu ñi'ook tu' dhi' kiicham gu novɨ gu gɨ'kora' gu Asiria; gio ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' kiicham gu ñi'ook xoi'kam tu' gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Dabii tu duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ jix dhaas bhaan tu jiim jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Esekîas ka't tu ñi'ook gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook nɨi'ñchudat gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jix tɨ'ɨ gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios vaik gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Isaiiyas; gio ba' dhi' nɨi'ñchudat gu oi'ñga'n gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' tu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' ɨkgiga'n mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Esekîas jix aa'; gio ba' buusnia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ɨkgiga'n gu chuukug mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; mi' dhɨr gu' ɨkgiga'n jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa'dham ñi'ook Jawatan gu Isaiiyas tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu gu ñi'ook ɨkgiga'n gu ux gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ ka't jix duñia' gu chuukug gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu suudai' gu mar gu Baladaan gu gɨ'kora' gu Babiloonia bhañ gu bhóogɨt gu oi'ñga'n gu Esekîas na gu' ka't naak gu Esekîas ka't gu vaak ka'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Esekîas jix kai jix duñia' bɨx gu vaak tu'x a'bhar jix toja jodai jix uam jodai gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui' maa'n; gio ba' gu vaak gu ñi'ook bɨx ka't gu jodai' na jix uam; mi' dhɨr matgɨm gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu Esekîas cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu vaak na ja'p bɨx aapi'.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas suudai' u'va gu gɨ'kora' gu Esekîas; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gui'p mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ duukat tɨɨtɨs tu' gu Esekîas jix aa'; mi' dhɨr gu jodai' oi'ñga'n jix duñia' tɨbiap gu Babiloonia.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' a'ga; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu vaak gu Esekîas jix aa'; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bɨx ka't gu vaak; jano' ba' cham tu' jix duñia' gu takarui' cham gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Isaiiyas gu Esekîas; gio ba' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
